problem: One canonical segment inherits Father label 'Lanfranc' although the text switches explicitly to 'PSEUDO-DIONYSIUS.' midway. A single Messenger author bubble would falsely attribute the second paragraph.
policy: Canonical Catena original text must not be rewritten or split destructively.
Speaker ownership by first inherited author is valid only before the explicit inline attribution marker.
Any source-owned renderer must use validated source substring boundaries and a clearly attributed display, not automatic one-bubble attribution.
Pseudo-Dionysius is a transmitted editorial author label, not the historical Dionysius the Areopagite with independently certified authorship.
One fragment may contribute multiple source-owner units, but none is yet approved for publication.
